title: Agent recipe
description: Where one coding agent keeps its instructions and hooks, and what its hooks are called. install.sh checks every recipe against this schema (types, required fields, no unknown fields, $ref) before it installs anything.

name.description: The agent's name, as messages show it.

variable.description: The environment variable the agent reads to move its directory, if it has one.

default.description: The directory when the variable is unset; a leading ~ is the home directory.

instructions.description: The file in home the agent reads into every session; the standards go in it between markers.

hook_config.description: The JSON file in home that registers hooks.

hook_section.description: Top-level key in hook_config holding the event map; defaults to "hooks".

status_message.description: Whether hook handlers accept a statusMessage field; defaults to true.

events.description: The agent's event and tool names for each moment a hook runs. A moment left out is not hooked.

after_edit.description: After the agent's edit tools change a file.

turn_end.description: When the agent finishes a turn.

edited_files.description: A jq filter that turns the after_edit hook input into the absolute paths of the files edited, one per output.

input.description: Optional jq filters for hook stdin fields that differ from Claude Code's defaults.

session_id.description: Extracts the session identifier; defaults to ".session_id // empty".

stop_active.description: True when turn_end is re-entering after a previous stop hook; defaults to ".stop_hook_active // false".

stop_when.description: Must evaluate to true for turn_end to check and hold the turn; defaults to "true".

output.description: Optional hook stdout shapes when the agent differs from Claude Code's defaults.

before_shell.description: Static JSON reply for before_shell pass-through; omitted prints nothing.

after_edit.description: Static JSON reply for after_edit pass-through; omitted prints nothing.

after_shell.description: Static JSON reply for after_shell pass-through; omitted prints nothing.

edit_block.description: Decision value when after_edit reports a problem; defaults to "block". Empty defers reporting to turn_end.

stop_allow.description: Static JSON reply when turn_end allows stopping; omitted prints nothing.

stop_block.description: Decision value when turn_end keeps the agent going; defaults to "block".

stop_warn.description: Static JSON reply when problems remain on re-entry; defaults to a systemMessage.

after_install.description: What the user still has to do once the installer is done.

matcher.description: The tool names it applies to, as the agent's matcher syntax.

flat.description: True when handlers sit directly in the event array without a {hooks: [...]} wrapper.
